notes.title: Muse V0.6.7 update announcement
notes.content:
Thanks for your support. The updated contents of this version are as follows:
1. Added props: 100% win card.
This is originally a puzzle game, but according to the feedback difficulty of player evaluation, in order to let some players experience the later content of the game, we made a quick prop.
2. Two 100% win cards will be given at the beginning of the game.

The others will coming soon.
